result.topic_en: A summary sheet of spherical trigonometry formulas for right-angled and oblique spherical triangles.
result.transcription:
Gauss Math. 32
Trigonometria sphaerica
Triangula rectangula
(1) $\cos a \cos b = \cos h$
(2) $\cos h \,\mathrm{tang}\, A \,\mathrm{tang}\, B = 1$
(3) $\sin h \sin A = \sin. a$
(4) $\mathrm{tang}\, h \cos A = \mathrm{tang}\, b$
(5) $\sin a \,\mathrm{tang}\, B = \mathrm{tang}\, b$
(6) $\cos. A = \cos. a \sin B$
Triangula obliquangula
(1) $\sin A \sin b = \sin B \sin a$
(2) $\cos. a = \cos b \cos c + \cos A \sin b \sin c$
(3) $\sin \frac{1}{2} A = \sqrt{\frac{\sin \frac{1}{2}(a+b-c) . \sin \frac{1}{2}(a-b+c)}{\sin b . \sin c}}$
(4) $\cos \frac{1}{2} A = \sqrt{\frac{\sin \frac{1}{2}(b+c+a) . \sin \frac{1}{2}(b+c-a)}{\sin b \sin c}}$
(5) $\sin A = \sqrt{\frac{4 \sin \frac{1}{2}(a+b+c) \sin \frac{1}{2}(a+b-c) \sin \frac{1}{2}(a-b+c) \sin \frac{1}{2}(b+c-a)}{\sin b^2 \sin c^2}}$
(6) $\mathrm{tang}\, B = \frac{\sin A}{\sin c \,\mathrm{cotg}.\, b - \cos A \cos. c}$
(7) $\mathrm{tang}. \frac{1}{2}(A+B) = \frac{+\cos \frac{1}{2}(a-b) \,\mathrm{cotang}. \frac{1}{2} C}{\cos \frac{1}{2}(a+b)}$
(8) $\mathrm{tang}. \frac{1}{2}(A-B) = \frac{+\sin \frac{1}{2}(a-b) \,\mathrm{cotang}. \frac{1}{2} C}{\sin \frac{1}{2}(a+b)}$
(9) $\cos A = \cos a \sin B \sin C - \cos B \cos C$
(10) (11) (12) formulae similes ut (3)(4)(5) pro $\sin \frac{1}{2} a$, $\cos \frac{1}{2} a$, $\sin a$.
